description:
Get one job in full: plain-text description (truncated to 8000 characters), salary,
        `open` and `closed_at`, `last_seen_at` (when a crawl last saw it open), every source
        posting it was merged from and their change history. Call after search_jobs with a
        job_id, or with a link. To only check whether a link is still open use
        check_job_link.

job_id.description: Job `id` from search_jobs, or a JobSweep job link such as https://jobsweep.works/jobs/145524, or the job's apply or source link.
job_id.title: Job Id

name: get_job
title: Get job details
